note: Canonical illustrated Order deck, separate from the 24-card Force deck. Three Orders in hand, one secret Order committed per Battle. Existing Order effects are unchanged.
used_for: One hidden, drawn, army-wide Order revealed before rolling D6. Cards are played and discarded once per Battle.

orders.title: Assault
orders.effect: Advance one surviving Force one empty rank forward in each Front.

orders.title: Hold
orders.effect: Withdraw one Force one empty rank per Front. Your Defend results can protect any ally in their Front.

orders.title: Volley
orders.effect: Your Archers may Attack any enemy in their Front, including Middle and Rear.

orders.title: Raid
orders.effect: Move one Raider, Rider or Skirmisher per Front to an empty same-rank space in an adjacent open Front. They may Attack enemy Middle or Rear.
